title: Staff Nurse
summary: Chennai City Urban Health Mission invites applications from eligible candidates for the engagement of Staff Nurses on a purely temporary contract basis under NHM norms. Interested candidates must submit their filled applications along with self-attested copies of relevant documents to the specified address on or before 07.12.2026 by 5:00 PM.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess GNM or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College recognized by the university approved under state norms.
Must have valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.
Maximum age limit is up to 50 years.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official NHM-TN website or Greater Chennai Corporation website.
Fill out the application completely and attach self-attested copies of all mandatory documents along with two recent passport-size colour photographs.
Send the filled application by post or deliver it in person to the office of the City Health Officer / Member Secretary, Chennai City Urban Health Mission on or before 07.12.2026 by 5:00 PM.
